settings.title: Bots created per spawn command
settings.description: How many bots the spawn command creates when you do not give a number.

settings.title: Largest single spawn
settings.description: Safety limit for one spawn command. Very large batches can freeze the server for a moment, so raise this only when nobody else is playing.

settings.title: Level mix of new bots
settings.description: How new levelling bots are spread over levels, as ranges with weights (1-20:40 means 40 parts of bots between level 1 and 20).

settings.title: Bring new bots online immediately
settings.description: Newly created bots log in right away instead of waiting in the database.

settings.title: Bot account name prefix
settings.description: Bots live on accounts that start with this name. Changing it makes existing bots stop logging in automatically.

settings.title: Bots created per step
settings.description: Creation is spread over time to keep the server smooth. Higher values are faster but can cause freezes.

settings.title: Pause between creation steps
settings.description: Time between creation steps. Lower values are faster but can cause freezes.

settings.title: Automatic bot login
settings.description: Existing bots log themselves in every time the server starts.

settings.title: Maximum bots online
settings.description: The most bots that log in automatically at startup.

settings.title: Bots logging in per step
settings.description: Logins are spread over time. Higher values bring bots online faster but load the server harder.

settings.title: Pause between login steps
settings.description: Time between login steps.

settings.title: Tank population target
settings.description: Share of bots that should be tanks.

settings.title: Healer population target
settings.description: Share of bots that should be healers.

settings.title: Talent data file
settings.description: Where the community talent builds are stored. Leave empty to use the built-in search.

settings.title: Bots wander the world
settings.description: Idle bots run errands: visit town services, travel to gathering or grinding areas, or wander a little.

settings.title: Questing AI
settings.description: Bots pick up and complete quests on their own. When off, bots only gather, fish, grind and wander.

settings.title: Town services search radius
settings.description: How far a bot looks for vendors and mailboxes.

settings.title: Errand area radius
settings.description: How far a bot looks for gathering or grinding areas.

settings.title: Errand check interval
settings.description: How often each bot reconsiders its errand.

settings.title: Idle time before an errand
settings.description: How long a bot must find nothing to do before it starts an errand.

settings.title: Detailed errand logging
settings.description: Writes every errand step to the log. Useful for debugging, noisy with many bots.

settings.title: Detailed combat logging
settings.description: Writes combat decisions to the log. Very noisy; turn on only while hunting a specific problem.

settings.title: Shortest activity
settings.description: The shortest time a bot sticks with one kind of activity.

settings.title: Longest activity
settings.description: The longest time a bot sticks with one kind of activity.

settings.title: Grinding search radius
settings.description: How far a bot looks for monsters to grind.

settings.title: Highest monster level to grind
settings.description: How many levels above itself a bot will fight while grinding.

settings.title: Emergency heal threshold
settings.description: Healers switch to their strongest heals when an ally falls below this health.

settings.title: Target search radius
settings.description: How far a bot scans for quest targets inside an objective area.

settings.title: Engage distance
settings.description: Distance at which a bot starts fighting a quest monster.

settings.title: Mount up beyond (min)
settings.description: Each bot mounts for trips longer than a personal distance drawn between this and the maximum.

settings.title: Mount up beyond (max)
settings.description: Upper end of the personal mount distance.

settings.title: Use flight paths beyond
settings.description: Trips longer than this use a flight path when the bot knows a route.

settings.title: Take breaks
settings.description: Bots alternate questing with a few minutes of town life, like a player would.

settings.title: Gather nearby herbs and ore
settings.description: Gatherers step off their path for a node right next to it.

settings.title: Maximum active quests
settings.description: How many quests a bot carries at once.

settings.title: Accept elite quests
settings.description: Solo bots take on elite quests. Off by default because they usually cannot finish them alone.

settings.title: Quests below own level
settings.description: How many levels below itself a bot still accepts quests.

settings.title: Quests above own level
settings.description: How many levels above itself a bot still accepts quests.

settings.title: Highest quest monster level
settings.description: How far above its level a quest monster may be.

settings.title: Farthest quest objective
settings.description: Quests whose objectives are farther than this are not taken.

settings.title: Quest giver search radius
settings.description: How far a bot looks for quest givers.

settings.title: Areas tried per objective
settings.description: How many areas a bot gives up on before setting the quest aside.

settings.title: Set-aside time (short)
settings.description: How long a quest is set aside after the bot gives up on it.

settings.title: Set-aside time (long)
settings.description: The longest a quest can stay set aside after repeated failures.

settings.title: Dungeon Finder bot fill
settings.description: When you queue alone for a dungeon, bots fill the missing tank, healer and damage roles.

settings.title: Bots queue for dungeons by themselves
settings.description: Experimental: idle tank bots queue for a dungeon on their own and the fill above completes the party.

settings.title: Battleground bot fill
settings.description: When anyone queues for a battleground, both teams are topped up with bots so the match starts at once.

settings.title: Battleground team size
settings.description: Bots per team to fill up to. 0 means a full team for that battleground.

settings.title: Bots help nearby players
settings.description: A passing bot joins a fight that a friendly player is losing, without taking their loot or credit.

settings.title: Help distance
settings.description: How close a bot must be to step into a fight.

settings.title: Help below health
settings.description: Bots help when the fighting player is below this health.

settings.title: Bots resurrect fallen players
settings.description: Bots that know a resurrection spell revive friendly corpses.

settings.title: Temporary bot parties
settings.description: Bots of similar level with the same quest briefly team up.

settings.title: Temporary party size
settings.description: Largest temporary party.

settings.title: Party formation distance
settings.description: How close bots must be to team up.

settings.title: Shortest party time
settings.description: Minimum duration of a temporary party.

settings.title: Longest party time
settings.description: Maximum duration of a temporary party.

settings.title: Planner interval (min)
settings.description: Shortest time between a bot's planning passes.

settings.title: Planner interval (max)
settings.description: Longest time between a bot's planning passes.

settings.title: Target scan interval (min)
settings.description: Shortest time between target scans.

settings.title: Target scan interval (max)
settings.description: Longest time between target scans.

settings.title: Area search time limit
settings.description: How long a bot searches an empty area before trying another.

settings.title: Approach time limit
settings.description: How long a bot walks toward a claimed target.

settings.title: Travel time limit
settings.description: How long a whole trip to an area may take.

settings.title: Preference weight: TravelPer100Yards
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: CrowdPerBot
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: Overlap
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: TurnIn
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: Accept
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: AreaOccupancy
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.

settings.title: Preference weight: TargetReserved
settings.description: How strongly bots weigh this factor when choosing what to do next. Change only if you know the planner.
